name: full-sentence-resonance
rule: Begin every independent sentence with exactly one of the 16 resonance markers.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: short-acknowledgment
rule: A single-word yes/no may be a fragment and may omit a marker; a finite complete clause may not.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: interrogative-end
rule: Keep the final he after a genuine complete direct question.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: wh-object-case
rule: The recorded object question form khe-m is licensed in the standard grammar.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: purposeful-ellipsis
rule: Use omissions only when the result is a non-sentential label or short answer.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: resonance-not-consent
rule: Warm or cheerful resonance never implies consent.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: repair-content
rule: The marker dënaro changes an earlier claim only when a specific corrected statement follows.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: repair-hearing
rule: Mishearing and retracting a prior proposition use different discourse cues.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: noncoercive-invitation
rule: tëqoro / pëshu mark non-pressure but do not manufacture agreement.
supported_example: më tëqoro ti mi-wa goro ya.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: reported-evidence
rule: hu is reported; si direct experience; ye inference; do not upgrade the evidence.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: modal-ability
rule: Ability -ki is a capacity claim, not permission.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: modal-permission
rule: Permission -ho cannot be inferred from ability or a cheerful tone.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: obligation
rule: -du is obligation; -yu is future and not the same thing.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: pronoun-referent
rule: ti-wa means with you; -tu recipient and -na possession must not be conflated.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: contrast-correction
rule: Use independent marked sentences for changes of resonance.
contrast_or_nonpreferred_example: nëm mi nu shiri, zha mi haro.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: shared-ground
rule: nësho means previously established common ground, not new evidence.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: paraphrase-versus-quote
rule: qëhano and wëlëmi frame different quotation relations.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: question-not-rhetorical
rule: An actually answer-seeking question is not automatically rhetorical.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: stated-uncertainty
rule: shurëmi marks unresolved content, not a yes or no answer.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: conditional-promise
rule: A conditional promise must state or unambiguously link its condition.
supported_example: qor këmëro wë ti goro, mi ti-m daru-yu.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: privacy-and-sources
rule: tënarë marks withheld-source stance, not verification.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: quoted-sentence
rule: Independent quoted Qaroshi sentences keep their own resonance.
supported_example: sen sa toru «më mi ti-m nashi.» shiri-te.
contrast_or_nonpreferred_example: sen sa toru «mi ti-m nashi.» shiri-te.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: latin-normalization
rule: Normalize NFC, preserve ë and digraphs. Do not replace ë with e.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged

name: one-discourse-frame
rule: A discourse frame is after resonance; avoid stacking incompatible quotation frames.
contrast_or_nonpreferred_example: sen qëhano wëlëmi mi ti-m nashi.
status: reviewed pedagogical restatement; canonical grammar unchanged
